n: 4.5 Cu. Ft. Ventless All In One Washer Dryer
desc: Do laundry the way you want in a large capacity all in one washer dryer that installs virtually anywhere. Whether your laundry area is a closet or mud room, fit this space saving washer dryer combo and wash, dry or wash and dry all in one appliance.
hl: Wash and dry an average sized load in 3.5 hours, all in one appliance.
Skip steps with the Load & Go™ XL Dispenser.
Whether you need to only run a wash cycle, just dry a few items or wash and dry a whole load, the All-In-One Washer & Dryer gives you the flexibility to do your laundry the way you want.
Closet, mud room or full-size laundry area—no matter what your space, take up less room and do laundry in one appliance instead of two.
This All-In-One Washer & Dryer provides enough room for day-to-day loads, while still fitting in the space that’s convenient for your family with a 4.5 cu. ft. capacity.
Keep clothes fresh for up to 12 hours after the wash or dry cycle has ended.
